welcome.title: Welcome to a clearer way to understand your matches
welcome.description: First we verify Rocket League and your account. Then we guide you through the actual app and point out every important tool.

setup.title: Let's connect the game and the right account
setup.description: We search real Steam and Epic installations and read local Steam accounts. You can always review the selection.
setup.searchingGame: Searching Steam, Epic and known locations…
setup.noGame: No valid installation was found. Paste the Rocket League folder to validate it, or continue and configure it later.
setup.noAccount: No local account was found. You can continue: the app will identify your exact PrimaryId when you join a match.
setup.detectError: Automatic detection could not be completed.
setup.invalidPath: That folder is not a valid Rocket League installation.
setup.saveError: The configuration could not be saved.

live.title: The match, as it happens
live.description: Live brings together the scoreboard, players, events and MMR. It starts listening automatically when Rocket League opens.

connection.title: A signal you can understand
connection.description: This indicator shows whether the local stream is connected, waiting for the game, or needs attention.

history.title: Every match stays saved
history.description: Return to previous results, filter matches and open the full detail without relying on external services.

analytics.title: Trends, not a wall of numbers
analytics.description: Analytics organizes sessions, progress and strengths so you can find real patterns.

players.title: Recognize returning players
players.description: The directory connects opponents and teammates with the history they share with you.

profiles.title: Each account keeps its own data
profiles.description: Use separate profiles to avoid mixing stats. Smart detection warns you when another account is active.

settings.title: Everything can be reviewed
settings.description: Settings lets you change identity, installation, overlay and privacy, or restart this guide.
